meta.notes: There is one sounds element per namespace, always named sounds. Each key is a sound event, here msm_examples:ruby.chime; the game picks one entry of sounds at random each time it plays. An entry is a sound file id (an .ogg under sounds/) or an object that also sets pitch, volume, weight or stream. Try /playsound msm_examples:ruby.chime master @s, and import your own .ogg files to replace the vanilla ones.
